description: This file defines a PHP class LeaveAPI within the namespace OrangeHRM\Leave\Api, implementing CRUD endpoints for managing leave requests in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving leaves associated with a leave request, updating leave statuses, and handling related validation and authorization logic. The class extends a base Endpoint class and uses multiple traits for additional functionality.

classes.name: LeaveAPI
classes.description: Controller class that manages leave-related API endpoints; includes operations for listing, updating, and validating leave requests within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.description: Method to retrieve a single leave resource; currently not implemented, throws exception.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne operation; currently not implemented.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches and returns all leaves associated with a leave request, including employee info and leave durations. Checks authorization and retrieves detailed leave data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll operation, primarily filtering by leaveRequestId and pagination parameters.

methods.description: Updates a leave entry's status (approve, reject, cancel) based on request body action parameter. Validates permissions and leave existence.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a leave, including positive leaveId and action string.
